name: fortsprite
description: Search released Fortnite Sprites and manage your FortSprite collection through its hosted MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Find released Fortnite Sprites, inspect their details and source links, review your saved collection and progress, and update ownership or mastery. Connect your FortSprite account through OAuth; collection access follows your consent and is limited to your account.
defaultPrompt: Show my FortSprite collection progress and what I am missing.
Find Birthday Sprites and show their details.
Help me update ownership and mastery in my FortSprite collection.
